claims.claim: Standard post-hoc calibrators improve calibration scores but not consistently selective prediction; calibration metrics can disagree with selective-prediction performance.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidate F; component verdict: NARROW (classification, not generation)
claims.quoted_support: (2) standard post-hoc calibrators often improve calibration scores but do not consistently translate into better selective prediction behavior; and (3) commonly used calibration metrics can disagree with selective prediction performance

claims.claim: Scope is deliberately restricted to defect prediction and vulnerability detection to avoid unresolved measurement issues in generative code tasks.
claims.stance_target: R1 candidate L1; component verdict: NARROW
claims.quoted_support: This allows us to assess behavioral calibration and selective prediction without conflating the analysis with unresolved measurement issues in generative code tasks.
